# React Native compatibility

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-compat.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

Every name exported by `react-native` 0.88 is exported here, so shared code always imports.
Ignored style props are accepted and logged once in development (silence them with `LogBox.ignoreLogs`).

Units: 1 = one terminal cell (one column horizontally, one row vertically).

## Components

| Name | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| View | Supported | Ink `<Box>` with React Native defaults (column, flexShrink 0), onLayout, measure |
| Text | Supported | Nesting and inheritance, numberOfLines/ellipsizeMode, textAlign, textTransform, onPress |
| TextInput | Supported | Controlled/uncontrolled, cursor editing, paste, multiline, secureTextEntry, maxLength, submitBehavior |
| Pressable | Supported | Enter/Space press, `{pressed, focused}` state, autoFocus; no long press |
| TouchableOpacity / TouchableHighlight | Supported | Dim / underlay feedback while pressed |
| TouchableWithoutFeedback / TouchableNativeFeedback | Supported | Focusable wrapper without an extra View |
| Button | Supported | `[ Title ]`, inverse when focused |
| Switch | Supported | `[● ]` / `[ ●]`, Space/Enter toggles |
| ActivityIndicator | Supported | Braille (small) or bar (large) spinner |
| ScrollView | Supported | Keyboard scrolling, indicator, scrollTo/scrollToEnd, focused children scrolled into view, RefreshControl spinner |
| FlatList / SectionList / VirtualizedList / VirtualizedSectionList | Partial | All features except virtualization (every item renders) |
| Modal | Supported | Opaque or transparent, focus scope, Esc → onRequestClose; content renders at the app root |
| Image / ImageBackground | Partial | PNG/JPEG drawn with half blocks (optional `pngjs` / `jpeg-js`); no require() assets |
| SafeAreaView / KeyboardAvoidingView | Supported | Plain Views |
| StatusBar / RefreshControl / InputAccessoryView | Stub | Render nothing (RefreshControl drives ScrollView) |
| DrawerLayoutAndroid | Partial | Renders the main content only |
| ProgressBarAndroid | Partial | Horizontal bar or spinner (deprecated in React Native) |
| unstable_Virtual* (VirtualView, VirtualArray, ...) | Stub | VirtualView renders its children; the rest render nothing |

## APIs

| Name | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AppRegistry | Supported | runApplication returns the Ink instance; getApplication for tests |
| StyleSheet | Supported | create, flatten, compose, absoluteFill, hairlineWidth (1) |
| Platform | Supported | `OS === 'cli'`, select({ cli, default }) |
| Dimensions / useWindowDimensions / PixelRatio | Supported | Terminal size in cells; ratio 1 |
| Animated / Easing | Supported | JavaScript driver; values, interpolation, timing/spring/decay, composition, events, components, hooks |
| Alert / ActionSheetIOS | Supported | Centered dialogs with focusable buttons; Alert.prompt |
| ToastAndroid | Supported | Timed message below the app |
| BackHandler | Supported | Esc when nothing is focused; exitApp exits the app |
| Keyboard | Partial | dismiss() blurs the focused input; no keyboard events |
| Linking | Partial | openURL with the OS opener; no incoming URLs |
| Appearance / useColorScheme / DynamicColorIOS | Partial | Detected from $COLORFGBG, or set with setColorScheme |
| AccessibilityInfo | Partial | isScreenReaderEnabled reflects Ink's screen-reader mode |
| LogBox | Partial | Filters this library's warnings |
| Clipboard | Partial | setString via OSC 52; getString returns the last value set |
| Vibration | Partial | Rings the terminal bell |
| processColor / PlatformColor | Supported | PlatformColor names the terminal palette (`redBright`, `ansi256(208)`) |
| I18nManager | Partial | Always left-to-right |
| Settings | Partial | In memory |
| EventEmitter / DeviceEventEmitter / NativeEventEmitter | Supported | Shared JavaScript emitter |
| AppState | Stub | Always 'active' |
| LayoutAnimation | Stub | Changes apply instantly |
| PanResponder | Stub | No touch input in terminals |
| Share / PermissionsAndroid / PushNotificationIOS / Networking | Stub | Safe no-ops |
| NativeModules / TurboModuleRegistry / UIManager | Stub | No native modules (empty / null) |
| requireNativeComponent / codegenNative* / NativeComponentRegistry | Stub | Throw when called |

## Layout styles

| Style | Status | Terminal behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width`, `height`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxHeight` | Supported | Cells or a percentage of the parent |
| `aspectRatio` | Supported | A number or an 'a/b' ratio string |
| `flex` | Supported | Expanded like React Native's Yoga: flex > 0 grows from a 0 basis |
| `flexGrow`, `flexShrink`, `flexBasis`, `flexDirection`, `flexWrap`, `justifyContent`, `alignItems`, `alignSelf`, `alignContent` | Supported | Same as React Native |
| `gap`, `rowGap`, `columnGap` | Supported | Cells |
| `margin`, `marginHorizontal`, `marginVertical`, `marginTop`, `marginRight`, `marginBottom`, `marginLeft`, `marginStart`, `marginEnd`, `marginBlock`, `marginBlockStart`, `marginBlockEnd`, `marginInline`, `marginInlineStart`, `marginInlineEnd` | Supported | Cells, percentages or 'auto'; a specific side beats its axis, which beats the shorthand |
| `padding`, `paddingHorizontal`, `paddingVertical`, `paddingTop`, `paddingRight`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingLeft`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBlock`, `paddingBlockStart`, `paddingBlockEnd`, `paddingInline`, `paddingInlineStart`, `paddingInlineEnd` | Supported | Cells or percentages; same precedence as margins |
| `position` | Supported | 'absolute', 'relative' or 'static' |
| `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`, `start`, `end`, `inset`, `insetBlock`, `insetBlockStart`, `insetBlockEnd`, `insetInline`, `insetInlineStart`, `insetInlineEnd` | Supported | Offsets in cells or percentages; start/end map to left/right |
| `display` | Supported | 'flex' or 'none' ('contents' is ignored) |
| `overflow` | Supported | 'visible' or 'hidden'; 'scroll' behaves as 'hidden' |
| `zIndex` | Ignored | Paint order is always tree order |
| `direction` | Ignored | Layout is always left-to-right |
| `boxSizing` | Ignored | Sizes always include padding and border |

## View styles

| Style | Status | Terminal behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backgroundColor` | Supported | Fills the box |
| `borderWidth`, `borderTopWidth`, `borderRightWidth`, `borderBottomWidth`, `borderLeftWidth`, `borderStartWidth`, `borderEndWidth` | Approximated | A side is drawn when its width is above 0; borders are always 1 cell thick |
| `borderColor`, `borderTopColor`, `borderRightColor`, `borderBottomColor`, `borderLeftColor`, `borderStartColor`, `borderEndColor`, `borderBlockColor`, `borderBlockStartColor`, `borderBlockEndColor` | Supported | Per-side border color |
| `borderStyle` | Approximated | 'solid', 'dashed' and 'dotted' pick a glyph set; Ink names ('double', 'round', 'bold', ...) are also accepted |
| `borderRadius`, `borderTopLeftRadius`, `borderTopRightRadius`, `borderBottomLeftRadius`, `borderBottomRightRadius`, `borderTopStartRadius`, `borderTopEndRadius`, `borderBottomStartRadius`, `borderBottomEndRadius`, `borderStartStartRadius`, `borderStartEndRadius`, `borderEndStartRadius`, `borderEndEndRadius` | Approximated | Any radius above 0 draws rounded corners |
| `opacity` | Approximated | Below 1 dims descendant text and borders; 0 hides content but keeps its space |
| `transform` | Approximated | translateX/translateY shift by whole cells without affecting layout; other transforms are ignored |
| `shadowColor`, `shadowOffset`, `shadowOpacity`, `shadowRadius`, `elevation`, `boxShadow`, `filter`, `backfaceVisibility`, `borderCurve`, `cursor`, `pointerEvents`, `isolation`, `mixBlendMode`, `outlineColor`, `outlineOffset`, `outlineStyle`, `outlineWidth`, `transformOrigin`, `experimental_backgroundImage`, `translateX`, `translateY`, `scaleX`, `scaleY`, `rotation` | Ignored | No terminal equivalent |

## Text styles

| Style | Status | Terminal behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | Supported | Text color |
| `fontStyle` | Supported | 'italic' (if the terminal supports it) |
| `fontWeight` | Approximated | Bold for bold/600+, dim for light/300 and below |
| `textDecorationLine` | Supported | 'underline', 'line-through' or both |
| `textTransform` | Supported | uppercase / lowercase / capitalize; inherited by nested Text |
| `textAlign` | Supported | left / center / right of the Text's box ('justify' behaves as 'left') |
| `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`, `fontVariant`, `includeFontPadding` | Ignored | Terminals use a single font size and family |
| `textDecorationStyle`, `textDecorationColor`, `textShadowColor`, `textShadowOffset`, `textShadowRadius`, `userSelect`, `writingDirection`, `textAlignVertical`, `verticalAlign` | Ignored | No terminal equivalent |

## Image styles

| Style | Status | Terminal behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resizeMode`, `objectFit` | Supported | How the picture fits its box |
| `overlayColor`, `tintColor` | Ignored | No terminal equivalent |
